details: A critical balance-handling vulnerability in the shared Cosmos EVM module was exploited, leading to funds being drained from six different blockchains between August 20 and August 25, 2026. Cosmos Labs, aware of the flaw since April, published details on August 28 after initially underestimating the risk. Affected versions require coordinated network upgrades.
title: Cosmos EVM Flaw Exploited, Draining Funds from Six Blockchains

details: Bitcoin experienced some profit-taking, falling 3.8% on August 29 as the broader crypto market saw a 2.9% decline. This follows a period of strong performance, with spot BTC ETFs recording a ninth consecutive day of inflows, adding $242 million on August 27 and pushing August's total inflows past $3 billion, marking the strongest month of 2026 for these products. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish speech at Jackson Hole also contributed to market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K Amid Profit-Taking, Strong ETF Inflows Continue.

details: Ethereum is trading around $2,496 on August 28, holding near the $2,500 level. While the daily chart shows bullish momentum, an overbought Relative Strength Index (RSI) indicates the potential for a pullback. The overall crypto market capitalization fell 2.9% in 24 hours, leading to declines across various altcoins such as NEAR, Kaspa, XDC, Pyth Network, Venice Token, Dash, and Uniswap.
title: Ethereum Consolidates Near $2,500; Broader Altcoins See Pullback.

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has proposed new rules titled "Regulation Crypto Assets," aiming to establish a clear framework for crypto asset offerings. The proposal includes two exemptions from Securities Act registration: one for offerings up to $5 million over four years, and another for up to $75 million in any 12-month period, both requiring principles-based narrative disclosures.
title: SEC Proposes New Regulatory Framework for Crypto Asset Offerings.

details: UK challenger bank Revolut has introduced EURR, an Ethereum-based, euro-denominated digital token, marking the initial phase of its stablecoin strategy. The phased rollout has commenced for eligible customers in Denmark, Poland, and Portugal, with plans for wider availability across other European Economic Area (EEA) markets later this year.
title: Revolut Launches Euro-Backed Stablecoin EURR on Ethereum.

details: Solana has approved a significant supply cut, which could reduce future issuance by nearly 18.9 million SOL over six years, impacting its tokenomics. Separately, institutional interest in Solana is growing, with reports indicating Charles Schwab plans to add Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink to its crypto offerings.
title: Solana Approved Major Supply Cut; Institutional Interest Grows.
